title: How to Get More Google Reviews Without Begging

scenes.say: How do you get more Google reviews without begging?

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: Here's the thing. Happy guests don't think about reviews. Maria loved her latte, then she just went back to work.

props.name: Maria
props.quote: Loved my latte. Totally forgot to *review* it.

scenes.say: So ask at the happy moment. When a guest says it was lovely, say thank you, and ask if they'd share that online.

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: Then reply to every review, short and warm. New guests read the replies, and they see someone who cares.

props.caption: Reply to *every* review
props.name: Maria
props.text: Best flat white in town, and they remembered my name.
props.reply: Thank you Maria! Your usual is waiting whenever you're ready.

scenes.say: So: ask when they smile. Make it easy with a small card and a link. And reply to every single review.
